description: Minimal notes CLI in C# (.NET 10). A teaching example of Harness Engineering, ported from the Python original betta-tech/ejemplo-harness-subagentes.
cli: In acceptance criteria, `notes <args>` is shorthand for `dotnet run --project src/NotesCli -- <args>`.

features.name: storage_layer
features.title: JSON storage layer
features.description: Atomic read/write of notes in a JSON file. Creates the file if it does not exist.
acceptance: src/NotesCli/NoteStorage.cs exists with Load() and Save(notes)
Save() is atomic (write to a temp file in the same folder + File.Move with overwrite)
Load() returns an empty list if the file does not exist
tests/NotesCli.Tests/NoteStorageTests.cs covers the 3 cases above

features.name: note_model
features.title: Note model
features.description: Immutable record that represents a note with Id, Title, Body, CreatedAt.
acceptance: src/NotesCli/Note.cs contains the sealed record Note
Note.New(title, body, existing) assigns an incremental id and CreatedAt in ISO 8601 (UTC, seconds)
tests/NotesCli.Tests/NoteTests.cs validates creation, id increment and immutability

features.name: cli_add_list
features.title: add and list commands
features.description: Add a note and list all existing notes.
acceptance: `notes add "title" --body "text"` prints the created id as `id=<n>`
`notes list` prints one line per note: `<id>\t<created_at>\t<title>`
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs covers both commands with a temporary file

features.name: cli_show_delete
features.title: show and delete commands
features.description: Show and delete notes by id.
acceptance: `notes show <id>` prints title, date and body (one per line)
`notes delete <id>` deletes the note and confirms with a message
Both commands return exit code != 0 if the id does not exist
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs covers success and failure

features.name: cli_search
features.title: search command
features.description: Substring search in title or body (case-insensitive).
acceptance: `notes search "word"` lists the notes that contain the word
If there are no matches, exit code 1 and a clear message
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs covers match, no match and case-insensitivity

features.name: cli_edit
features.title: edit command
features.description: Change the title and/or body of an existing note by id.
acceptance: `notes edit <id> --title "new"` updates only the title
`notes edit <id> --body "new"` updates only the body
Passing both flags updates both fields in the same call
If no flag is passed, exit code != 0 and a clear message
If the id does not exist, exit code != 0 and a message on stderr
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs covers success (each flag and both), missing id and no flags

features.name: cli_recent
features.title: recent command
features.description: List the N most recent notes, ordered by created_at descending.
acceptance: `notes recent` lists the 5 most recent notes by default
`notes recent --limit 10` changes the number
Order is by `created_at` from newest to oldest
Each line follows the format `<id>\t<created_at>\t<title>` (same as `list`)
If there are no notes, exit code 0 and nothing is printed (consistent with `list`)
If `--limit` is <= 0, exit code != 0 and a clear message on stderr
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs covers: default order, custom limit, empty file, invalid limit

features.name: cli_description
features.title: description change
features.description: The description line of the general help text says TEST23 instead of `Minimal notes CLI.`.
acceptance: `notes --help` prints `TEST23` as the description line instead of `Minimal notes CLI.` (stdout, exit 0)
The general usage printed on stderr for `notes` with no command (and for an unknown command) also shows `TEST23` instead of `Minimal notes CLI.` (exit 2)
The rest of the general help (the usage line and the command list) and all exit codes are unchanged
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs asserts that `TEST23` is present and `Minimal notes CLI.` is absent, for both `--help` and no command

features.name: cli_conventions_cleanup
features.title: Cli.cs conventions cleanup
features.description: Fix pre-existing docs/conventions.md violations in src/NotesCli/Cli.cs flagged by the feature 7 and 8 reviews, with no change in behaviour.
acceptance: Every line in src/NotesCli/Cli.cs is at most 120 characters (line 224 in `ParseArguments` is 123 today)
`GeneralUsage()` builds its lines with a collection expression instead of `new List<string> { ... }`
`GeneralUsage()` uses no `+` string concatenation (today it appends `+ Environment.NewLine`)
The general help output (`notes --help`, `-h`, no command, unknown command) is byte-for-byte identical to commit 8e30cd7, and all exit codes are unchanged
tests/NotesCli.Tests/CliTests.cs pins every full row of the command list (signature and help columns), not just the command names
All existing tests still pass
